annotations.title: A company's numbers, on the record

description: An AI company's numbers, each labeled: what its own founders and executives stated in interviews Real Alpha cut (revenue, run rate, users, customers, headcount, margins, burn, valuation, growth, going public), in their words with the show, the date and a link to the minute; Real Alpha's own estimate of its revenue run rate, with a range, where it has one; and the figures its Real Alpha page reports, with their sources. Use it when someone asks a private AI company's revenue, ARR, valuation, users, customers or headcount, or what its leaders have said about them. Quote a figure with its label: "Stated" by the company's people, "Reported" by a news outlet, filing or release, "Real Alpha estimate", or "Analyst estimate" from another firm. Up to 30 stated figures, newest first.
name: company_numbers

answer.description: The answer its page opens with

estimate.description: Real Alpha's estimate of its revenue run rate

how.description: How Real Alpha estimates, and its track record

page.description: Its page on realalpha.app, with every figure and source: the link to cite

reported.description: Revenue and valuation figures its page reports, each with its source

stated.description: Figures the company's own people stated, newest first

cite.description: A line to credit it by

kind.description: revenue, run_rate, users, customers, headcount, margin, burn, valuation, growth or ipo

url.description: The moment or the episode from that minute: the link to cite

when.description: The month or year it is for, or "said <month>" when the speaker didn't say

tip.description: What to try when nothing matched
